QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Third Seal
QuestInfo.0: You reach the final seal at last. Your allies are still fighting, so break the seal and obtain the powers within.
QuestInfo.1: You reach the final seal at last. Your allies are still fighting, so break the seal and obtain the powers within.
QuestInfo.2: Apparently, Luce was an ancient god. Fearing her older sister, Noctis, the gods of Tallahart stole Luce's power and sealed away Noctis. So that's what that bad feeling was about...
